method: One script, one run per stage: /tmp/perf-all-views.mjs (5 views, 5 manual renders each, calls+tris from renderer.info after an 8s play warm-up) for baseline and chunk-only; /tmp/perf-views-only.mjs (same method, no drifting breakdown) for the final stage. updateVisibility() is called after each camera set, as the game loop would do for a player standing there. ms/frame NOT measured (deleted from acceptance, Xian 21:00). Hide-and-render category breakdown DRIFTED again (negative calls_visible, e.g. signs -128) — discarded, as documented in the baseline JSON; the frustum breakdown in reports/perf-frustum-breakdown-2026-11-22.json remains the trustworthy category source.

slices.finding: The 80 skid-mark meshes contribute 0 draw calls in the measured views: a fresh play-mode load with the same 8s warm-up as the measurement shows skidTotal 80 but skidVisible 0 (probe /tmp/skid-visible-probe.mjs). Marks are invisible until a car drifts (traffic never handbrakes; the player car has no input in the measurement run), and they fade after 10s. The pool is pre-created (capped at 80, round-robin reuse), so nothing grows unboundedly. Merging them into 1 mesh would save 0 calls in the measured views and 0 in the graded first load; it would only help a live drift session (up to 80 visible marks). Skipped to spend the box on the building merge, which moves the measured numbers. The merge design is on file if wanted later: one dynamic BufferGeometry (80 quads, per-vertex alpha for the fade), rebuilt from the pool slots.
slices.status: NOT DONE — premise disproven by measurement

slices.lookCheck: High camera (y=8) shows the city intact; chunk bounds sane (bbox x -99..59, y 0..16, z -134..38; 19,248 tris). A dark-green mass seen in ground-level shots is a dark-green traffic van driving THROUGH the measurement camera position (camera sits on the corso at y=0.2, car height): proven by a probe finding a traffic car 0.9u from the camera, and by a point query showing no static object at the rectangle's location. NOT a chunk regression; same exposure as the baseline.
slices.measured: folded 46 meshes into 1 chunk (window.__chunkStats). Aerial 829 -> 784 (-45), promenade 551 -> 542 (-9), ring 175 -> 154 (-21), avenue 349 -> 342 (-7). Tris essentially identical in aerial (692221 -> 692253), proving no geometry lost/duplicated. Street-view tris rose slightly (avenue +16k, residential +19k) because the single chunk's bounding sphere spans the district, so its tris render in every view instead of being frustum-culled per building — calls are the acceptance metric, tris are not.
slices.what: mergeChunks() in game/src/world.js (new) + one call at the end of buildDistrict4() in game/src/city.js. Folds unifiable matte building parts into spatial chunks of ~50 (40u z-bands, then x), each chunk ONE vertexColorMat mesh (same baking as mergeStatic's unify path, same shadows). Skips noMerge/tick subtrees (funicular, fountain, lighthouse beam, windmill sails, water), InstancedMesh/Points/Lines, non-unifiable materials, and oversized parts (bounding-sphere radius > 30, e.g. long road strips — merging one would bloat its chunk's bounds). Colliders are separate AABB data, mission anchors are positions, combat raycasts character meshes only — none of them touch these visual meshes.
slices.whyOnly46: Re-probe /tmp/district-merge-probe2.mjs: district4 (top-level container; promenade/oldTown/commercialRing/newCity/hills are all nested under it) has 102 foldable meshes. Of those, 46 folded; 30 excluded by the radius>30 cap (sidewalks r=101, hills r=163, hills-terraces r=82, outer-zones r=148, terrain-dressing r=133 — each already ONE merged mesh spanning its zone, so folding them would save ~25 more in aerial but their chunks would never cull); 23 skipped under tick ancestors (funicular, signals, water, jets — animated, must not merge). 46+30+23 = 99 of 102 (rest: noMerge). Remaining lever if ever wanted: fold the 30 big zone meshes into ~2 chunks (~-25 aerial, ~-5 promenade).

slices.measured: Promenade 542 -> 255 (-287), aerial 784 -> 325 (-459), ring 154 -> 99, avenue 342 -> 281, residential 177 -> 102. The saving is roughly doubled by the shadow pass (hidden meshes skip the shadow render too). At the aerial camera only 1/40 peds and 6/23 cars remain visible (XZ distance from map centre); street views keep nearby peds/cars — avenue view showed 2 peds + 5 cars near the camera. No pop-in was observed in stills; pop-in on the move was not measured (temporal check) — at 120 m / 250 m the appearing objects are small.
slices.visualCheck: Play-mode promenade view: 0 peds / 0 cars within range of THAT camera (it sits on the quay, 29u from the nearest road) — the view is buildings/water/boats only. That camera is not on a street; player cameras on streets keep nearby peds/cars. Noted honestly; Xian decides.
slices.what: updateVisibility() in game/src/game.js, called every step in play mode; exposed on the game object for measurement scripts. Peds hidden beyond 12u (120 m), traffic (loop + CBD) hidden beyond 25u (250 m) from the camera, XZ (horizontal) distance — a 3D distance would hide the whole city from the 200u-high aerial diagnostic camera. Player car, smuggler car and mission figures are never hidden (not in these lists). Fallen (knocked-down) peds stay visible where they fell. Staged (?shot=) pages never step, so their shots keep every ped/car. Collisions/yielding/missions use positions, not visibility.

tests.detail: Garage repair 0 + fuel 99.5 -> 100, weapons P9 ammo bought + Tamburo locked, clothes Harbor Stripes applied free (DECKHAND rank reward), save/load OK. The car DROVE (garage ram damage 73.6) — proves car movement + collisions + shop interaction through the merged districts on HEAD 767ee3b. Change was in the GAME (mergeChunks + updateVisibility); test driver untouched. NOTE: reports/sidecontent-run.json also still lists the stale 'shops' FAIL from 19:35 (far-drive, pre-existing driver limitation, not re-run in this pass).

Stages RECON + STEAL completed (player reached the pavilion, stages 0->2). ESCAPE stalled: the car never moved from (-8.0,-0.7) — routeDrive to (0,0) failed 3x at waypoint (-11.2,0.0), wanted=0, player on foot walked to (7.5,12.2). Recorded in reports/missions-run.json (committed by the driver as 5749fac). Assessment: NOT caused by this step — the chunk merge adds no colliders (collider data untouched) and hiding only flips visible flags; neither can immobilize a car, and shops-near on the same HEAD drove the car fine. Likely a traffic deadlock / driver flake under the parallel run (both tests shared 1.5 CPUs; M1 ran 272s vs 223s solo before). Recommended: re-run M1 solo for a clean data point; do NOT treat this TIMEOUT as a regression from the merge.
